Read ci-cold-compilation-failure.json. Exact prior macOS CI 38816257215 retains three original first-open failures at 5813/7527/6472 ms against 5000 ms, with identical 609 rows, 40 students and 520 evaluations. The earlier local full recorder and successful sibling-seed control do not override that failure.

Read the preserved compiler investigation and diagnostic log SHA256 59f9b4b3bbcb4a41830da537dc7c73958822438e3aa1c59760eff1faf94797ad. Worker-only diagnostic 38823234859 repeats the unchanged original same-page D1 prefix twice: 16 passes, retries 0; large opens 1334/504 ms and 1459/306 ms. Other unbounded prefix opens compile more slowly; no universal native-cold-cache or full-CI performance claim follows.

Reviewed the complete broker diff and new compiler source. Only compilation moves into a short-lived worker started on the first real cache miss, inside existing measured startup. It calls compileStreaming on the exact same-origin URL and returns immutable compiled code. It imports no SDK and creates no WebAssembly.Instance, engine memory, VFS, database or connection.

The compilation producer belongs to the page module-cache promise, not an individual startup scope. Consumer cleanup still terminates only its own SDK workers and ports. The compiler's settled guard removes all three listeners, clears its timer and terminates on success, error reply, worker error, messageerror, malformed result, send/constructor exception or its unchanged 30-second deadline. A rejected cache entry is removed so a later explicit open can retry; no automatic retry was added.

Verified broker request key/origin checks and the compiler's own request/origin validation. A direct isolated Node probe imported the actual compiler module: same-origin minimal WASM compiled, cross-origin and malformed requests returned error with zero fetches, and the registration remained one-shot. This module probe is not browser/offline evidence.

Independently ran the current broker unit file: success true, 11 passed, 0 failed/pending.
